opus.procedural_disposition: qualified: all-command optional-lock compliance is not established

mandatory_findings.title: One shared storage entry point, cache identity and honest unit sequencing
mandatory_findings.recommendation: Assign smart_read small/large storage and cache admission to an explicit injected shared ingestion entry point; separate raw stored chunks from summarization windows and classify derived records. Reconcile INGEST/TOOLS-DOC allowlists and completion gates together.

mandatory_findings.title: Durable embedding-space identity and unbound legacy-store admission
mandatory_findings.recommendation: Use fresh bound stores for the new convention; specify create/reopen/read/write enforcement, same-dimension model/preparation mismatch and precomputed-vector identity. Refuse legacy-unbound use by the new pipeline without scanning, resetting or migrating it; this recommendation is not a newly approved behavior.

mandatory_findings.title: Complete query/document embedding role inventory
mandatory_findings.recommendation: Inventory retrieval/lifecycle/maintenance as well as ingestion; give discovered role corrections exact owners and paths. Do not enable asymmetric preparation while a relevant caller remains unclassified.

mandatory_findings.title: Missing embedding-capacity fields and legacy constructors
mandatory_findings.recommendation: Define how model-catalog and non-catalog constructors obtain verified capacity/dimensions and which operation refuses when those cannot be established. No silent unguarded bypass and no accidental whole-application configuration break.

mandatory_findings.title: Document strategy for text and other non-Docling sources
mandatory_findings.recommendation: Assign normalization/block segmentation and packaging so document/512 works for text/headless consumers, with no hidden strategy fallback or undeclared Docling requirement. Freeze the missing-extra behavior for document formats.

mandatory_findings.title: Local model-bound tokenization and nonblocking execution
mandatory_findings.recommendation: Use provisioned offline synchronous token assets for repeated chunk counts, with a declared asset root and worker execution/cancellation contract; server tokenization may cross-check rather than serve as a per-split network bridge. Verify feasibility on the selected release at gate A.

mandatory_findings.title: Office structural admission and observable omissions
mandatory_findings.recommendation: Explicitly permit a bounded read-only structural audit that can refuse or report coverage but never supplies text, or narrow the claimed guarantees. Freeze format detection, warning/refusal and resource limits on the selected release.

mandatory_findings.title: Actual web and automatic-tool routes versus future capability
mandatory_findings.recommendation: Keep the all-source policy decision, but identify maintained entry points, legacy-only callers and absent routes. Decide whether a new route is authorized or is future work; an absent route earns no integration-test credit. Do not invent a new web fetcher under this review.
